qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Irreplaceable network of ~100+ permitted landfills and exclusive secondary-market municipal franchises creates localized disposal monopolies protected by insurmountable NIMBY zoning and EPA/provincial permitting barriers. Demonstrated pricing power with core price yield compounding at 5-8% annually above cost inflation with negligible customer churn. Tangible Operating ROIC of 18.5% and >130% FCF conversion confirm an unassailable economic moat. Primary erosion threats: localized landfill capacity exhaustion and evolving PFAS leachate remediation mandates, both hedged by long-term fee pass-through clauses.
